cosy-lesson.title: "The same rain that hurts the ice cream seller helps the umbrella seller.": Proverb

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Perspective – a particular attitude toward or way of regarding something; a cognitive standpoint.

p.em: Example: Depending on your perspective, a rainy day can feel like a setback or a cozy opportunity.

cosy-blockquote.p: Proverb – a simple, concrete saying popularly known and repeated, expressing a general truth or piece of advice.

p.em: Example: This ancient proverb teaches us that every difficult event has a positive side for someone else.

cosy-blockquote.p: Fortune – chance, luck, or destiny as an external force that affects human life and affairs.

p.em: Example: He had the good fortune of meeting an invaluable mentor early in his career.

cosy-blockquote.p: Setback – a temporary difficulty, disappointment, or reversal in your progress.

p.em: Example: Losing his job felt like a terrible setback, but it forced him to explore his true passions.

cosy-blockquote.p: Optimism – hopefulness, confidence, and a positive outlook regarding the future or outcomes of events.

p.em: Example: Adversity is difficult to handle if you do not possess a healthy dose of optimism.

cosy-blockquote.p: To benefit – To receive an advantage, profit, or highly positive gain from an event or situation.

p.em: Example: Local umbrella shops always benefit when a sudden summer rainstorm starts in the city.

cosy-blockquote.p: To affect – to produce a change or make a difference to someone or something.

p.em: Example: Bad weather can severely affect the daily trade of open-air ice cream sellers.

cosy-blockquote.p: Adversity – difficulties, misfortune, or hard times that challenge a person's resilience.

p.em: Example: How we handle adversity is a true measure of our character and wisdom.

cosy-blockquote.p: Trade – a particular business, craft, or commercial industry (such as selling goods).

p.em: Example: Online commerce has completely changed the traditional retail trade in our cities.

cosy-blockquote.p: Subjective – based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, biases, or opinions.

p.em: Example: The concept of a 'good day' is highly subjective, depending on your individual perspective.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
What is the central message of this elegant proverb regarding our standpoint?
★ When was the last time a change in your plans brought you unexpected good fortune?

How does our individual perspective shape how we experience a sudden physical setback?
★ Do you find it easy to maintain optimism when facing a difficult life setback?

Why does a major crisis in one industry often allow another trade to grow and benefit?
★ Has a change in technology ever managed to benefit your personal career?

How does global economic crisis affect local businesses and family-owned shops?
★ Do you believe that your personal happiness is highly subjective?

Why is experiencing a level of adversity necessary to develop a strong character?
★ What is the most valuable lesson you learned from facing a major adversity?

Is it possible for competitors in the same trade to benefit from each other's success?
★ Do you maintain a healthy sense of optimism when competing with colleagues?

How does a person's perspective change when they move from an ordinary job to self-employment?
★ Have you ever had a business idea that was born during a minor personal setback?

Why does our subjective view of events make it difficult to find objective facts?
★ Are you always aware of how your emotions affect your logical decisions?

Can a society fully focused on comfort ever survive a period of sudden, heavy adversity?
★ Where do you find your main source of strength during hard times?

If you could write your own proverb about life and fortune, what would it say?
★ If you had to describe your relationship with fortune in one word, what would it be?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: Discuss with your partner: In which scenario is it easiest to find a positive benefit despite the initial setback? Rank them: - 🌧️ Summer Rainstorm Hurts the open-air ice cream trade completely, but greatly benefits the local umbrella seller. - ✈️ Flight Cancelled A highly disappointing setback for your vacation, but it might protect you from a larger, unseen travel crisis. - 💻 Tech Automation An algorithm automates half of your weekly tasks, threatening your old routine but freeing up time for original creativity. - 🚧 Park Renovation A local quiet park closes for six months, but it will preserve natural aesthetic beauty for future generations.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 guided visual description and task response with teacher.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
In the future, automated systems will predict and balance our business fortune with absolute certainty. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you be happier if technology completely eliminated the risk of setbacks?

Future social networks will use smart glasses to transfer our subjective perspective directly to others. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you want to experience another person's perception of a difficult day?

The rapid speed of future automation will ensure that no retail trade ever suffers from bad weather. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ If your job were automated, how would you preserve your active vigor?

As AI manages all resources, humans will face no physical adversity, leading to a state of complacency. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ If you faced zero challenges, how would you keep your life meaningful?

In the coming decades, choosing not to conform and maintaining persistent optimism will be highly rewarded. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you believe that optimism is a biological trait or a learned habit?

Future school systems will completely eliminate exams, teaching children how to benefit from adversity instead. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you think future kids will be more resilient than today's children?

Future generations will look back at our current rigid proverbs with deep skepticism and shock. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ If you could send a single message about the beauty of staying hopeful to people 100 years in the future, what would it be?

Global digital connectivity will make it incredibly simple for multiple niche trades to cooperate and benefit together. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you choose to live in a futuristic utopia that completely guarantees safety at the cost of your freedom?

In tomorrow's world, social status will be determined by how much you can benefit others rather than your material wealth. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ What role do you hope personal optimism will play in your own professional future over the next decade?

A future world fully governed by logic will have no space left for the mystery of subjective fortune. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ In what area of your life do you want to exercise greater personal choice right now?

ul.li: Incorrect: It hurts my ice cream sell → Correct: It hurts my ice cream business / trade ((Elevating vocabulary: 'trade' matches the proverb's context better than verb 'sell'.))
Incorrect: Rain is positive to umbrella seller → Correct: Rain is positive for the umbrella seller / benefits the umbrella seller ((Preposition 'for', or use transitive verb 'benefits' directly.))
Incorrect: I am agree with this proverb → Correct: I agree with this proverb (('Agree' is a verb and does not take auxiliary 'am'.))

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Reflection & Feedback: Review language highlights and key corrections with your teacher.
